title: Vintage Toshiba Strobo Lite Computer 7028 Flash Swivel Foot Tested Working +
descriptionText: The Vintage Toshiba Strobo Lite Computer 7028 Flash Swivel Foot is a shoe mount flash unit designed to fit cameras with a hot shoe interface. This model features a swivel function, allowing for flexible positioning and creative lighting effects. Tested and confirmed to be in working condition, this light offers a reliable and high-quality strobe lighting solution for photographers looking to add a professional touch to their work. The Toshiba brand ensures durability and performance, making it a valuable addition to any photography setup.
